providerDefinitions.name: Codex
providerDefinitions.description: Connect an existing official Codex CLI account.

methods.label: Use an existing sign-in
methods.description: Use the official runtime's signed-in account on this host. Credentials stay with that runtime. Saving settings does not start sign-in or test a model.

providerDefinitions.requirements: Install the qualified Codex CLI 0.157.0 on this host and complete its official sign-in first. Select its executable and account directory under Advanced settings when needed. Other versions require adapter qualification.

providerDefinitions.requirements: Install Claude Code and sign in through its official runtime on this host first.
